summary: Wrote two independent, non-production GDScript test files implementing every functional witness required by EQUIPMENT-LIFETIME-R01v1 against the actual candidate `inventory.gd` public API (as shown in the supplied source, verbatim method/refusal names — no invented API). `godot/test/test_equipment_authority_lifetime.gd` is a discovered `test_case.gd` suite covering: bind-time rejection of an authority missing the attestation method; a failed rebind preserving the previous live binding; `clear()`
